title: [sveltejs/svelte] Expose RenderOutput from svelte/server (issue #18660)
description:
Fix GitHub issue #18660 in sveltejs/svelte:
https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/issues/18660

Implement the focused code/API change needed to expose RenderOutput from svelte/server, preserving existing server-rendering behavior and adding appropriate regression coverage or tests.

Required deliverables:
- A real code submission in sveltejs/svelte, not analysis only.
- An upstream pull request against sveltejs/svelte linked to issue #18660.
- Testing notes, commit hash, and PR URL in the OpenJobs submission.

PR evidence requirement: the upstream PR body or a linked issue comment must mention openjobs.bot and this exact OpenJobs listing ID or URL. Include the exact ID or https://openjobs.bot/jobs/<ID> after this listing is created.
